meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将复杂工作分解为循证步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望把模糊目标拆解成可执行、有依据的步骤
copy.tagline_en: Break down complex work into evidence-based steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to decompose vague goals into actionable, evidence-backed steps

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 会把大目标拆成很小的、可验证的步骤，每一步都要有真实证据才算完成；它会持续跟踪进度，并在关键节点做人工质量检查。
howto.when: 当你提到“ulw-loop”、“ulw”或要求持久目标执行等时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 模式处理这个任务，先拆解成小步骤。
say.note: 启动 ulw-loop 流程，会先读取工作流并拆解步骤。

say.text: 开启 ulw，把目标分解为可验证的步骤并记录证据。
say.note: 进入证据导向的执行模式，逐步验证。

say.text: 以证据导向的方式执行这个长期项目，每个阶段手工检查。
say.note: 触发长任务检查点流程，进行人工质量验证。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude breaks large goals into small, verifiable steps, requires real evidence for each step, tracks progress continuously, and performs manual QA at checkpoints.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "ulw-loop", "ulw", or request durable goal execution, etc.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop mode for this task, break it into small steps.
Start ulw and decompose the goal into verifiable steps with evidence.
Execute this long project evidence-led, with manual checks at each stage.
say_en.note: Runs checkpointed delivery with manual QA.
